answers.what: Deeper is a free add-on for AI assistants such as ChatGPT, Claude, or Gemini.
answers.does: It rewrites your request before the AI answers, aiming to make it more like an expert-written prompt. The small test in the video suggests this can improve how the AI uses your facts, works, checks its answer, and follows your instructions.
answers.who: It appears to be for anyone using an AI assistant who wants better answers, including people using coding tools. The video does not say that you need technical experience.
answers.next: Go to deeper.tools/start, copy the provided text, and paste it into a ChatGPT chat. Then type “/deeper” followed by your request.
